sources.story_title: The circulating claim — Lauren Howard (ALFA): small boat fishermen prefer EM over human observers, so improving AI-EM is a direct win for the fixed gear fleet

sources.outlet: Ai.Fish / Pacific States Marine Fisheries Commission
sources.story_title: Counter-evidence (primary): 2023 field study — AI-assisted EM review mean error 2.7% vs 1.3% human review, humans still verify haul-by-haul, AI significantly poorer under camera occlusion (supplement, not substitute)
Counter-evidence (primary): NOAA Alaska EM page — no mention of AI-assisted review; EM is a compliance tool alongside (not replacing) observers; fixed-gear EM is a voluntary annual opt-in
